About me

I started freelancing in 2019, exploring social media and content creation while studying. What started as curiosity eventually became a career.

Since then I’ve worked with businesses in different industries and taken on different responsibilities. Being a good virtual assistant isn’t just about knowing tools. It’s about being resourceful, dependable, detail-oriented, and willing to learn.

I’ve done everything from answering customer questions and managing orders to creating social media content, editing videos, researching leads, and supporting marketing initiatives.

New platform, process, or tool? I’m comfortable learning it and finding a way to work with it.

What I enjoy most? Making things easier for the people I work with. I like taking a messy task and turning it into something organized and manageable.
